story.title: The Little Mermaid
story.description: A young mermaid trades her voice and her very nature for a chance at human love - and an immortal soul.
story.author: Hans Christian Andersen

chapters.name: Daughter of the Sea
chapters.summary: The youngest of six sisters wants the surface before she is allowed it, and once she has seen it she is told what wanting it will cost.

chapters.name: The Bargain
chapters.summary: The Sea Witch states her terms in full and keeps them exactly. What she leaves out is not a lie - it is simply not asked.

chapters.name: Daughter of the Air
chapters.summary: The prince marries the woman he believes saved him, and the little mermaid is offered one way out that requires her to take a life.

scenes.name: The garden with the statue
scenes.summary: Each of the six princesses has a plot of the palace garden to keep as she likes. The youngest plants hers round with nothing but red flowers and a marble boy sunk from some wreck, and keeps it exactly so.

scenes.name: Fifteen, and the surface
scenes.summary: On her fifteenth birthday she is finally allowed to rise. She surfaces beside a ship lit for a birthday of its own, and sees a prince who is close enough to watch and too far to speak to.

scenes.name: A rescue in silence
scenes.summary: The storm breaks the ship apart. She holds the prince above water all night and leaves him on the sand at the temple steps, then watches from the shallows as a girl from the temple finds him and is thanked for it.

scenes.name: The price of a soul
scenes.summary: Her grandmother explains what she has never had to explain before: mermaids live three hundred years and end as foam, and the only path to an immortal soul runs through a human who loves her above all others.

scenes.name: Beyond the whirlpools
scenes.summary: She swims past the boiling whirlpools and the polyp forest to the Sea Witch, who is neither surprised to see her nor pleased. The Witch knew she would come and has the price ready.

scenes.name: Voice for legs
scenes.summary: The terms are stated plainly: her tongue for the potion, legs that walk like knives, and no way back. If the prince marries another, she becomes foam on the first morning after. She agrees to all of it.

scenes.name: Every step like knives
scenes.summary: She wakes on the shore with legs and no voice, and the prince finds her there. She dances better than anyone at his court, and every step costs her exactly what she was told it would.

scenes.name: A silent companion
scenes.summary: She becomes the prince's favourite, sleeping on a cushion at his door. He tells her, kindly and often, about the temple girl who saved his life - to the one person who could correct him and cannot.

scenes.name: The neighbouring princess
scenes.summary: The prince is sent to meet a neighbouring king's daughter he has no intention of marrying. She turns out to be the girl from the temple steps, and he believes he has found his rescuer at last.

scenes.name: A royal wedding
scenes.summary: The wedding is held aboard ship, and the little mermaid carries the bride's train. She dances that night better than she ever has, knowing the terms and the hour, and says nothing because she cannot.

scenes.name: Her sisters' gift
scenes.summary: Before dawn her sisters break the surface with their hair shorn off. They have traded it to the Witch for a knife: if she kills the prince before sunrise, the blood on her feet will make her a mermaid again.

scenes.name: Foam and air
scenes.summary: She stands over the sleeping prince with the knife, and throws it into the waves instead. She dissolves into foam at sunrise - and rises, not as nothing, but among the daughters of the air, with a soul to earn by her own work.

characters.name: The Little Mermaid
characters.description: The youngest of the Sea King's daughters, quieter and more dreaming than her sisters. She gives up the two things that make her herself - her voice and her form - and never once asks for either back.
characters.personality: Dreamy, quiet, and willing to endure great pain for a love she barely knows.
characters.motivation: Longs for an immortal soul, which only a human's love can grant a mermaid.
characters.qualities: Selfless to a fault, and graceful even in constant, silent pain on her new human legs.
characters.weaknesses: Gives up her voice entirely to pursue the Prince, leaving her no way to explain who she truly is.
characters.biography: The youngest daughter of the Sea King, who trades her voice to the Sea Witch for legs and a chance to win a prince's love.
characters.plannedTimeline: Cannot bring herself to kill the Prince to save her own life, and dissolves into foam - only to rise again among the daughters of the air.

characters.name: The Sea King
characters.title: King of the sea
characters.description: The widowed ruler of the undersea kingdom and father of six daughters, who keeps the rule about fifteen because his mother kept it before him.
characters.personality: Dignified and protective, though distant in the way of a ruler with many duties.
characters.motivation: Wants his daughters to be content within the sea kingdom, mermaid customs and all.
characters.qualities: Respected throughout the undersea kingdom as a fair and steady ruler.
characters.weaknesses: Has no power to stop his youngest daughter once she sets her heart on the world above the waves.
characters.biography: The widowed ruler of the undersea kingdom, raising six mermaid daughters with the help of his own mother.
characters.plannedTimeline: Remains in the Sea Kingdom throughout, aware only secondhand of his daughter's fate above the waves.

characters.name: The Grandmother
characters.description: The old queen, the only one below who has thought seriously about souls. She answers her granddaughter honestly, which is exactly what sets everything in motion.
characters.personality: Wise and fond of her granddaughters, happy to indulge their curiosity about the human world.
characters.motivation: Wants to prepare the little mermaid for the world above, even while doubting she will ever truly reach it.
characters.qualities: Knowledgeable about both mermaid tradition and human customs, a rare bridge between the two.
characters.weaknesses: Her warnings about the price of a soul go unheeded once the little mermaid's mind is made up.
characters.biography: The Sea King's mother, who first tells the little mermaid about the immortal soul that only humans possess.
characters.plannedTimeline: Remains in the Sea Kingdom, her warnings about the cost of an immortal soul proven true by the story's end.

characters.name: The Sea Witch
characters.description: A sorceress beyond the whirlpools who states every term of a bargain out loud and keeps all of them. She is not cruel; she simply does not volunteer what nobody thinks to ask.
characters.personality: Shrewd and unsentimental, willing to help only in exchange for something precious.
characters.motivation: Collects payment in rare and costly things - here, the little mermaid's own voice.
characters.qualities: Powerful enough to grant human legs, though never without a painful cost.
characters.weaknesses: Her bargains are always technically honest, but designed so the price is almost impossible to pay without loss.
characters.biography: A sorceress living beyond the sea kingdom's currents, who brews the potion that gives the little mermaid human legs in exchange for her voice.
characters.plannedTimeline: Never appears again once the bargain is struck, her potion's terms playing out to the letter.

characters.name: The Prince
characters.description: A prince pulled from a shipwreck who spends the story being kind to the wrong person for the right reasons. He never learns who actually saved him.
characters.personality: Kind and fond of his mute companion, though his heart belongs to someone else entirely.
characters.motivation: Wants to find and marry the girl he believes saved his life after the shipwreck.
characters.qualities: Warm and genuinely affectionate toward the little mermaid, even without knowing her full story.
characters.weaknesses: Never suspects that the silent girl at his side is the one who truly saved him.
characters.biography: A prince saved from drowning after a shipwreck, unaware that his silent companion at court is his actual rescuer.
characters.plannedTimeline: Marries the princess he believes saved him, never learning the little mermaid's sacrifice.

characters.name: The Neighbouring Princess
characters.description: The girl from the temple steps, raised in a neighbouring kingdom. She did find the prince on the sand, and she believes what everyone believes, which makes her innocent of the whole misunderstanding.

locations.name: The Sea
locations.description: Everything above the palace and below the sky. It is where the shipwreck happens, where the sisters surface, and where the story both begins and ends.
locations.climate: Deep, cool waters far below the reach of sunlight at its furthest halls.
locations.culture: A merfolk court that treasures song and storytelling about the human world above.
locations.politics: Ruled by the Sea King, widowed and raising six mermaid daughters alone.

locations.name: The Sea Kingdom
locations.description: The coral and amber palace of the Sea King, where six princesses are raised on stories of a surface none of them may see before fifteen.
locations.climate: Murky and treacherous, reached only by swimming past dangerous whirlpools.
locations.culture: A lair of one, governed entirely by the Witch's own bargains and terms.

locations.name: The Palace Garden
locations.description: Six plots of garden, one for each princess. The youngest keeps hers bare of everything but red flowers and a marble boy salvaged from a wreck, which is the first sign of where she is looking.
locations.climate: Sunlit and airy, a world of light utterly unlike the deep sea kingdom below.
locations.culture: A human royal court where the little mermaid, unable to speak, communicates only through dance and expression.
locations.politics: Ruled by the Prince, soon to be wed to a neighboring kingdom's princess.

locations.name: The Witch's Lair
locations.description: A house built of drowned bones past the boiling whirlpools and the polyp forest. Everyone who comes here comes knowing the price, because the Witch always says it first.

locations.name: The Prince's Palace
locations.description: The seaside castle where the prince lives, and where the little mermaid spends her days walking on knives among people who have no idea she is doing it.

worldRules.title: The Price of a Soul
worldRules.description: Mermaids live three hundred years and then become foam on the water, with nothing after. A human soul is immortal, and a mermaid can only come by one if a human loves her more than father and mother and marries her - which no mermaid has ever managed.

worldRules.title: Every Step Like Knives
worldRules.description: The potion gives real human legs, and every step taken on them feels like treading on knife blades. The pain never lessens and is never visible, so she is admired for her dancing by people who cannot tell what it is costing.

worldRules.title: The Sea Witch Never Cheats
worldRules.description: Every bargain past the whirlpools is stated in full and kept to the letter. The Witch takes the voice she asked for and gives the legs she promised. What she never does is volunteer the consequence of the terms being met - and nobody has thought to ask.

notes.title: Continuity: she cannot correct him
notes.body: From the moment she drinks the potion she has no voice and cannot write. Every scene at court has to work as a scene where the one fact that would fix everything is physically unavailable to the only person who knows it.

notes.title: Visual motif: the statue and the prince
notes.body: The marble boy is in her garden before she ever sees a human face. Stage the first sight of the prince so the reader recognises the statue before she says anything about it.

notes.title: Revision goal: nobody in this story is cruel
notes.body: The Witch keeps her word, the prince is kind, the princess is innocent, the grandmother is honest. The tragedy has to come out of what each of them does not know, never out of malice.

items.name: The Sea Witch's Potion
items.description: A potion brewed with the Witch's own blood that turns a tail into legs. It works exactly as described, including the part about every step feeling like walking on knives.

items.name: The Enchanted Knife
items.description: A knife the Witch will part with for the right price. Used before sunrise on the man the little mermaid loves, it would undo the bargain and give her back the sea.

items.name: The Marble Statue
items.description: A marble boy sunk from some wreck, standing in the youngest princess's garden long before she has any idea whose face she is looking at.
